input.summary: Time the plunge to stop and collect a 5K tunnel value. Repeat the center red Collect Tunnel target while the value is at least 3K. Change a low value through safe top play.

quickInfo.name: Tunnel value
quickInfo.summary: The tunnel cycles from 1K through 5K until the Stop Tunnel switch near the top of the plunger lane scores.

quickInfo.name: Tunnel skill shot
quickInfo.summary: A timed near-full plunge can stop the tunnel and collect it through the top-center Collect Tunnel lane.

quickInfo.name: Center Collect Tunnel
quickInfo.summary: The center red standup collects the displayed tunnel value and raises the center post.

quickInfo.name: Start Tunnel
quickInfo.summary: The top saucers and side standups restart the tunnel cycle when the displayed value is too low.

quickInfo.name: Gates
quickInfo.summary: Each top saucer opens one gate, and a gate passage scores points and collects the tunnel value.

steps.text: Align the plunger for the top-center Collect Tunnel lane.
Watch the tunnel lamps. Release a near-full plunge so the Stop Tunnel switch selects 5K.
Collect the selected value through the top-center lane.
When the tunnel shows 3K or more, hit the center red Collect Tunnel target near its middle.
Let the target rebound settle toward a flipper and the raised center post.
Use a dead bounce or drop catch to control the ball beside the center post.
Use small flipper taps to prepare the next center-target shot.
Repeat the center target while the tunnel stays at 3K or more and the rebound remains controlled.

fallback.title: Recovery: Change a low tunnel value
fallback.when: Recovery pivot: Use this plan when the tunnel shows 1K or 2K.

steps.text: Do not repeat the center Collect Tunnel target for the low value.
Use the left Collect Bonus shot, an open gate, or a safe shot toward the top.
Let a top Start Tunnel saucer restart the value cycle.
Stop the cycle at 3K or more, then return to the center target.

alternatives.title: Position play: Two-step tunnel plunge
alternatives.when: When trailing, use this distinct scoreboard route: use this plan only when a soft plunge can stop the tunnel more accurately on this machine.

steps.text: Soft-plunge only far enough to score the Stop Tunnel switch at 5K.
Let the ball return to the plunger lane.
Plunge through the top-center Collect Tunnel lane.
Use the one-step near-full plunge if the soft plunge cannot stop the value reliably.

alternatives.title: Open-gate collect
alternatives.when: Use this plan when a top saucer opens a gate and the gate shot is already available.

steps.text: Confirm that the gate is open.
Take the gate passage for points and a tunnel collect.
Do not chase the gate when a high-value center-target shot is controlled.
Stop the tunnel at 5K during the plunge.
Collect the 5K value through the top-center lane.
Hit the center red target to raise the center post.
Control each rebound and repeat the 5K target collect.

playfieldReferences.label: Collect Tunnel target
playfieldReferences.description: Center red target used to collect the currently lit tunnel value.
playfieldReferences.context: Repeat the center Collect Tunnel target while its value is worthwhile.

techniques.name: Timed near-full plunge
techniques.instruction: Set the plunger position before you watch the tunnel lamps. Release the plunger when the timing will stop the value at 5K.

techniques.name: Drop catch
techniques.instruction: Use a dead bounce or drop catch after the center-target rebound. Settle the ball beside the raised post, then use small taps to change flippers.

techniques.name: Centered target hit
techniques.instruction: Hit the center red target near its middle. An edge hit sends the rebound toward a slingshot or outlane.

cautions.issue: The two white buttons above the slingshots lower the center post.
cautions.response: Watch the post after either button scores. Prepare to flip or trap without depending on the post.

cautions.issue: An edge hit on the center red target can rebound toward an outlane or slingshot.
cautions.response: Aim for the middle of the target. Stop repeating it when the rebound does not return toward a flipper or the post.

cautions.issue: The side Start Tunnel standups can produce dangerous rebounds.
cautions.response: Use top saucers, the left Collect Bonus shot, or an open gate to change a low value when possible.
